info.name: Retrieve license usage in time range

params.name: orgId
params.description: ID of your ControlUp organization. You can find your organization ID on the [API Key Management page](how-to-make-api-requests#how-to-find-your-controlup-organization-id) in the DEX platform.

params.name: timeFrom
params.description: Start date and time for the usage data range in ISO string format (UTC).

params.name: timeTo
params.description: End date and time for the usage data range in ISO string format (UTC).

params.name: childOrgsIds
params.description: Array of organization IDs to filter the usage data by.

items.docs:
Returns license usage data for your organization over a specified time range.
For managed organizations, returns usage for that organization.
For MSP organizations, returns aggregated usage across all managed organizations.
